concept-art-generator.summary: Generates concept art from isolated style references using GPT Image or a trained LoRA. Requires human approval before exporting transparent 2K finals.
concept-art-generator.caption: ART WORKFLOW
concept-art-generator.visual_description: Separate style references feed a draft; a human approval gate precedes a transparent image export.

qwen-image-lora-studio.summary: Trains private Qwen-Image LoRA adapters on captioned artwork, then serves image generation through Gradio and an asynchronous API. Supports background removal and upscaling.
qwen-image-lora-studio.caption: IMAGE ADAPTATION
qwen-image-lora-studio.visual_description: A frozen weight matrix plus two thin trainable matrices illustrates LoRA adaptation for Qwen image generation.

FLUX-1-dev.summary: Gradio workbench for FLUX.1-dev inference and LoRA training on image-caption pairs, with quantization and multi-GPU training options.
FLUX-1-dev.caption: MODEL ADAPTATION
FLUX-1-dev.visual_description: Captioned images train a small LoRA adapter around a quantized FLUX base model; a feedback arrow denotes training.

Runeboard.summary: Hex-and-card strategy game with layered Utility AI, blackboards, hierarchical task planning, behaviour trees, and an MLP for strategic decisions.
Runeboard.caption: GAMEPLAY AI
Runeboard.visual_description: A route on a hex map is paired with hierarchical task decomposition into possible game actions.

videogamesAI.summary: Collection of game-AI implementations and articles: C++ pathfinding, Unity behaviour trees and blackboards, local LLM integration, and Unreal gameplay examples.
videogamesAI.caption: GAME AI METHODS
videogamesAI.visual_description: A branching behaviour tree reads from and writes to a blackboard of shared game state.

NazgulsUnleashed.summary: Crusader Kings III submod for Realms in Exile, extending Nazgul territories, cultures, characters, units, and scenario rules.
NazgulsUnleashed.caption: MOD DEPENDENCIES
NazgulsUnleashed.visual_description: Adjacent territories and ruler locations accompany the submod’s documented culture, court, unit, and rule changes.

c.summary: C++ shortest-path finder for a 2D grid, using Dijkstra with movement checks, matrix helpers, and tests for edge cases.
c.caption: SHORTEST PATH
c.visual_description: A highlighted shortest route navigates around blocked cells in a two-dimensional grid.

mindcraft.summary: Python library for NPC dialogue using LLMs, retrieved world lore, short- and long-term memory, personality, mood, and motivations. Supports streamed inference with vLLM.
mindcraft.caption: RETRIEVAL + GENERATION
mindcraft.visual_description: World lore and character memory supply context to an LLM; personality conditions dialogue and interaction feeds memory.

toxicity_es_transformers_shap.summary: Toxic-news classification with XLM-RoBERTa and Hugging Face Trainer, Optuna tuning, and SHAP explanations of model predictions.
toxicity_es_transformers_shap.caption: EXPLAINABLE CLASSIFICATION
toxicity_es_transformers_shap.visual_description: Highlighted text tokens align with signed SHAP attribution bars around a neutral baseline; bars are conceptual, not benchmark results.

documentqa_back.summary: Document question-answering backend built with FastAPI, LangChain, OpenAI, and Chroma vector storage. Includes user authentication and Docker deployment.
documentqa_back.caption: DOCUMENT QA BACKEND
documentqa_back.visual_description: Document chunks populate a vector index; a question retrieves context for a source-grounded answer.

documentqa_front.summary: React and Vite frontend for the document question-answering application, paired with the Document QA backend.
documentqa_front.caption: DOCUMENT QA CLIENT
documentqa_front.visual_description: A compact client interface separates document selection from question entry and returned answers.

libreCatastro.summary: Collects Spanish cadastral records and property plans from XML services or HTML, indexes them in Elasticsearch, and visualizes locations in Kibana.
libreCatastro.caption: GEOSPATIAL DATA PIPELINE
libreCatastro.visual_description: Property parcels and a spatial query connect cadastral records to an index and geographic visualization.

TeaNLP-front.summary: Angular frontend for TeaNLP: a graph-based interface for transforming, extracting, and analyzing text.
TeaNLP-front.caption: NLP WORKFLOW CLIENT
TeaNLP-front.visual_description: An editor palette and node canvas illustrate the Angular frontend for composing NLP graph workflows.

TeaNLP.summary: NLP graph project for transforming, extracting, and analyzing text; the documentation includes part-of-speech tag references.
TeaNLP.caption: NLP PROCESSING
TeaNLP.visual_description: A sample sentence carries part-of-speech tags and grammatical links, illustrating structured NLP annotations.

sparknlp-huggingface-gradio.summary: Demonstrates a Spark NLP named-entity recognition pipeline using a model from Hugging Face, with a Gradio interface and biomedical training data.
sparknlp-huggingface-gradio.caption: NAMED ENTITY RECOGNITION
sparknlp-huggingface-gradio.visual_description: A disease mention is highlighted in biomedical text above the tokenizer, embedding, and named-entity stages.

medium.summary: Index of technical articles on Spark NLP deployment, API serving, MLflow tracking, Hugging Face integration, and document-cluster visualization.
medium.caption: TECHNICAL WRITING
medium.visual_description: An article page sits beside a small serving-code excerpt, representing the repository’s technical writing index.

anonymizer.summary: Combines Flair neural entity recognition with regular expressions to anonymize text extracted from PDFs, including names, dates, and Spanish identifiers.
anonymizer.caption: HYBRID ANONYMIZATION
anonymizer.visual_description: Neural recognition identifies names and dates while regex detects an email; the output masks those text spans.

unsupervised_learning.summary: Repository for Spanish-language unsupervised-learning teaching materials. Its current contents are an introductory README.
unsupervised_learning.caption: TEACHING REPOSITORY
unsupervised_learning.visual_description: Three unlabeled point clouds illustrate the teaching topic of discovering structure; no experiment results are claimed.

supervised_learning.summary: Spanish-language machine-learning teaching materials, including classification practice notebooks, solutions, and lecture slides.
supervised_learning.caption: SUPERVISED LEARNING
supervised_learning.visual_description: Labeled points and a separating boundary illustrate supervised classification practice, not measured model performance.

graph_snippets.summary: Cypher snippets for importing Gremlin JSON nodes and edges into Neo4j.
graph_snippets.caption: GRAPH DATA IMPORT
graph_snippets.visual_description: A JSON node-and-edge structure maps into a connected property graph through Cypher imports.

borme.summary: Company and person CSV datasets with Logstash configurations and Elasticsearch setup scripts for indexing and exploring relationships in Kibana.
borme.caption: COMPANY DATA PIPELINE
borme.visual_description: A bipartite-style network shows people linked to companies, the relationships explored after CSV ingestion.

news_classifier.summary: Compares statistical classifiers on HuffPost news, with configurable text features, Doc2Vec embeddings, and train/test splits.
news_classifier.caption: TEXT CLASSIFICATION
news_classifier.visual_description: News becomes a feature matrix shared by alternative classifiers; no comparative accuracy is fabricated.

josejuanmartinez.summary: GitHub profile README introducing AI engineering, game development, professional experience, and links to selected work.
josejuanmartinez.caption: PROFILE INDEX
josejuanmartinez.visual_description: A profile symbol accompanies the documented areas of professional work.

josejuanmartinez.github.io.summary: Static portfolio organizing public repositories and gameplay recordings, published through GitHub Pages.
josejuanmartinez.github.io.caption: PORTFOLIO BUILD
josejuanmartinez.github.io.visual_description: A miniature browser contains a personal introduction and a grid of repository cards.

SoulsRandomizers.summary: Fork of randomizers for Dark Souls III, Sekiro, and Elden Ring. Item placement accounts for progression dependencies and configurable weighting.
SoulsRandomizers.caption: CONSTRAINED RANDOMIZATION
SoulsRandomizers.visual_description: Items are permuted across locations while respecting progression constraints rather than unconstrained shuffling.

SoulsFormatsNEXT.summary: Fork of a .NET library for reading and writing FromSoftware game formats, including archive and compression handling.
SoulsFormatsNEXT.caption: FORMAT SERIALIZATION
SoulsFormatsNEXT.visual_description: Raw binary bytes map to a structured archive object and back through format readers and writers.

SoulsIds.summary: Fork of C# modding helpers built around SoulsFormats, including an in-memory graph for assigning meaningful names to game IDs.
SoulsIds.caption: MODDING UTILITIES
SoulsIds.visual_description: Relationships among numeric game IDs help build meaningful names in the modding helper library.

yet-another-tab-control.summary: Fork of a Windows Forms control that supports custom, user-drawn tabs.
yet-another-tab-control.caption: CUSTOM UI CONTROL
yet-another-tab-control.visual_description: Differently rendered tabs show the selected state above a Windows Forms content panel.

RealmsInExile.summary: Fork of the Lord of the Rings total-overhaul mod for Crusader Kings III, covering characters, territories, events, and worldbuilding.
RealmsInExile.caption: TOTAL-CONVERSION MOD
RealmsInExile.visual_description: An abstract game map and connected worldbuilding categories illustrate a total-conversion mod, not a geographic claim.

making-games-with-ai-course.summary: Fork of the Hugging Face Machine Learning for Games course, containing lesson sources and notebooks.
making-games-with-ai-course.caption: COURSE MATERIALS
making-games-with-ai-course.visual_description: A lesson notebook is paired with a small game environment, reflecting course theory and practical exercises.

deep-rl-class.summary: Fork of the Hugging Face Deep Reinforcement Learning course, containing lesson sources and notebooks.
deep-rl-class.caption: REINFORCEMENT LEARNING
deep-rl-class.visual_description: The reinforcement-learning loop sends an action to the environment and returns state and reward to the agent.

openedgar.summary: Fork of the OpenEDGAR framework for retrieving and parsing SEC EDGAR filings into databases, with Docker installation support.
openedgar.caption: FINANCIAL DOCUMENT INGEST
openedgar.visual_description: SEC filing documents are parsed into structured fields and persisted in a database.
